rules.title: Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order for Year 2026, Rent Board Regulation 1148
rules.requirement: Eligible landlords may raise 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026. The AGA is set at 65% of the Bay Area CPI increase; it may not adjust rents for tenancies beginning on or after January 1, 2025 whose rents were set under Costa-Hawkins.
rules.key_value: 65% of Bay Area CPI change; 1.0% for 2026 (CPI 1.5% for Jul 1, 2024 - Jun 30, 2025)
rules.citation: Berkeley Municipal Code section 13.76.110A; Rent Board Regulation 1148
rules.status_basis: Adopted by the Rent Stabilization Board at its October 16, 2025 meeting; increase allowed no earlier than January 1, 2026.

coverage.summary: Applies to rental units under Berkeley's rent stabilization ordinance.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Tenancies beginning on or after January 1, 2025 with rents set under Costa-Hawkins are not adjusted by the 2026 AGA.

rules.quoted_span:
The 2026 AGA of 1.0% represents 65% of the increase in the Consumer 
Price Index (CPI) for All Urban Consumers in the Bay Area during the period from July 1, 
2024 - June 30, 2025, which was 1.5% as posted by the Bureau of Labor Statistics.
